tenderAddress.blockNumber: KARNATAKA RESIDENTIAL EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS SOCIETY, NO.8, MSB-1, 6TH FLOOR, CUNNIGHAM ROAD

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and condition as per Tender Document
All the documents/Annexures related to this tender uploaded/submitted should be issued/certified by the competent authority.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Should have executed supply of Food and Vegetable items (Perishable and Non Perishable) with a Average Annual work value not less than 70 % of the bid amount as a single or Multiple order to any of the State / Central Government Departments / organisation in India, during preceding three financial years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23 and 2023-24.The Bidder shall have work order and supplied 80% Vegetable items (Perishable items) and 80 % Food items (Non Perishable items) exclusively mentioned in SECTION IV.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copies of the Purchase / work orders, Annexure C1, Satisfactory completion certificate as per Annexure D

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should have supplied vegetable and food items to any of State / Central Government Department / Organisations in India at least 80% of the requirement of the quantity mentioned in the Tender Document in any one of the last 3 financial years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23 and 2023-24.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copies of the Purchase/work orders in quantity, Annexure C2.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: A Company, Firm, Individual Proprietorship, Non-governmental organization registered under law, Co-operative Societies registered under Societies act with an experience of more than 5 years in Bulk Supply of Food and Vegetable Items (Perishable or Non-Perishable food items) to any of the State or Central Government Department or organisation are eligible to participate.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Company / Establishment / Organisation Registration certificate, PAN Number, Copy of Work orders, Annexure A.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Towards financial capability, the bidder should have Average Annual turnover equal to the value of the bid amount during preceding 3 financial years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23 and 2023-24.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Audited Statement of Accounts, IT and GST Returns file, CA Certified 3CA/3CB/3CD, Certificate issued by the CA with UDIN number as per Annexure B.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Shall have Liquid assets consisting of Cash in Hand plus cash at bank plus term deposits / liquid funds with bank plus availability of fund based credit facility in any nationalized or scheduled commercial bank issued between the date of publishing of tender and last date of submission of tender shall not less than 40% of the amount put to tender.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Bankers Certificate as per Annexure E.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have valid and related FSSAI certificate.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of the valid certificate of FSSAI Certificate.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have a License Certificate (Form-C)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of the valid License Certificate (Form-C) issued by FSSAI as per Annexure F.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Local Presence: In order to ensure supplies across the District, as on the last day of bid submission the bidder should have local supply centre / warehouse within the district for which they are submitting the tender.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of the GST registration Certificate or Rental Agreement or any other valid document as per Annexure G.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Submission of Samples and Test Reports as per Section IV - Appendix II of the Bid Document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certified report of the samples. The bidder should submit the statement of compliance as per Section IV specification for each of the item

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder / Original Manufacturer should not have been debarred / blacklisted by any State Government, Central Government, Central and State Govt. Undertakings / enterprises / Organizations and by any other Quasi Government bodies / Organizations, World Bank / Govt E-marketing portal or any major Enterprise / Organization in India for non-satisfactory performance, corrupt and Fraudulent or any other unethical business practices, not meeting critical conditions / security clearance etc during the past.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Should provide an undertaking in the form of an Affidavit as per Annexure H.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) proof of EMD payment
Consortiums are not allowed to participate in the Tender as per RFP.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Should comply with letter head.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Attestation certificate obtained from Legal Metrology Department.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Any other document as mentioned in the tender document
